description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldcurrency_id, which extends SugarWidgetFieldEnum. The class provides methods for handling currency display, retrieval, and sorting in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment, specifically for currency ID fields in views and reports.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldcurrency_id
classes.description: Handles display and sorting of currency ID fields within the CRM, including retrieval of currency lists and display formatting.

methods.name: getCurrenciesList
methods.description: Returns a list of currency beans, including the default system currency, with optional cache refresh.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Overrides default display to show currency symbol and ISO code for a currency ID, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: queryOrderBy
methods.description: Generates an ORDER BY clause for currency ID fields, taking into account default currencies not stored directly in app lists.
